chunks.text: Mock supervision report 1. Progress toward the development objective is rated Satisfactory. Implementation progress is Satisfactory. Overall risk is Moderate.
Mock supervision report 1. Cumulative disbursement is 2 percent of the loan. Mobilisation of the first works contract is under way.
Mock supervision report 2. Progress toward the development objective remains Satisfactory. Overall risk is Moderate. Contract REF-001 is behind its mobilisation schedule.
Mock supervision report 2. Cumulative disbursement is 6 percent of the loan. Land acquisition delays are noted.
Mock supervision report 3. Progress toward the development objective is downgraded from Satisfactory to Moderately Unsatisfactory. Overall risk rises from Moderate to Substantial.
Mock supervision report 3. Fiduciary risk is Substantial: procurement packages were re-bid after low participation, and bid validity expired on two packages.
Mock completion report. Bid validity shorter than the evaluation and approval period forced re-bidding on two works packages and added months to the closing date.
Mock completion report. Splitting a large works contract into smaller lots raised the number of bidders and shortened the time to award.
Mock completion report. Late land acquisition delayed site handover; contract amendments extended time by 14 months in total.
Mock procurement guidance. Bid validity should cover the evaluation period plus the time for approvals and contract signing, with a margin.
Mock procurement guidance. Performance security for works contracts is commonly set between five and ten percent of the contract price.
Mock procurement guidance. Evaluation of bids is normally completed within a few weeks of bid opening for works contracts without a prequalification stage.
Mock supervision report for P-MOCK-002. Progress toward the development objective is rated Satisfactory and overall risk is Moderate.
Mock supervision report for P-MOCK-002. The pipe supply tender was cancelled when no compliant bids were received and was re-issued.
Mock supervision report 2 for P-MOCK-002. Ratings are unchanged. Disbursement is 9 percent of the loan.
Mock supervision report for P-MOCK-003. The project is not yet effective; progress toward the objective is rated Satisfactory.
Mock completion report. Prequalifying bidders for the complex bridge package reduced the number of unresponsive bids and shortened evaluation by about three weeks.
Mock completion report. Contract amendments for time were approved late, so liquidated damages could not be applied and two contractors stayed on site without cover.
Mock completion report. A single consultant framework for design and supervision reduced procurement time but weakened independent review of design changes.
Mock procurement guidance. The evaluation report should record each bidder against the stated criteria, and the award should be made within the bid validity period.
Mock procurement guidance. A standstill period lets unsuccessful bidders ask for a debrief before the contract is signed.
Mock procurement guidance. Amendments that change time or value should be recorded with a reason, approved before they take effect and reported with the next supervision report.
Mock procurement guidance. Planned and actual dates for mobilisation and completion should be recorded for every works contract so delays can be seen early.
Mock procurement guidance. Quality-based selection suits assignments where the quality of the advice matters more than cost; the shortlist normally has between three and six firms.
Mock appraisal document for P-MOCK-001. Works above the national threshold are procured by open competitive tender; REF-001 and REF-002 are the first two packages.
Mock appraisal document for P-MOCK-001. Land acquisition and late payment to contractors are identified as the main implementation risks.
Mock procurement plan for P-MOCK-001. Contracts REF-003 and REF-004 are shopping and limited competitive packages with expected signing in the first half of 2026.
Mock procurement plan for P-MOCK-001. Contract REF-005 covers survey services selected on quality, and REF-006 covers drainage works.
Mock bid evaluation report for contract REF-001. Three bids were received and opened; the lowest evaluated bid was recommended for award.
Mock safeguards plan for P-MOCK-001. Contractors prepare a site-specific management plan before mobilisation; contract REF-002 requires river protection measures.
